newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil exports $418 mln in February's second week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil exports $418 mln in February's second week.

text.p: Brazil exported $418 million worth of goods in the second week of February, with average daily exports at just $139.3 million, a Ministry of Industry and Commerce spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said the week had just three days due to the carnival holiday.
The second week result brought total February exports so far to $1.33 billion or $166.2 million a day, she said.
In the second week of January, exports were $812 million with a daily average of $162.4 million.
Brazil posted a $413 million trade gap in January with exports of $3.685 billion, averaging $167.5 million a day.
In 1996, the country saw a record trade deficit of $5.54 billion, which is expected to widen further this year to at least $8.0 billion.
